If it wasn't clear from our **' First Draft'**
[newsletter](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/06/business/media/trump-jail-
journalists-fighter-crew.html) yesterday, **Zeteo** will not be at today's
White House Correspondents' Dinner.

We will not join our media colleagues in partying with Donald Trump, an
authoritarian who seeks to curtail the First Amendment and [criminalize
journalism](https://zeteo.com/p/journalists-stop-partying-with-donald), who
puts masked agents on the street to racially profile and kidnap people and
[kill people](https://zeteo.com/p/senate-democrats-trump-dhs-funding-alex-
pretti), who [jails foreign students](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-mahmoud-
khalil-to-be-released) for their pro-Palestine speech, who seeks to
[denaturalize US
citizens](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/04/23/us/politics/justice-dept-
citizens-denaturalization.html), who has made it US policy to [summarily
execute](https://zeteo.com/p/second-strike-all-of-the-us-strikes) people at
sea, who is [massacring children](https://zeteo.com/p/gaza-iran-children-
minab-killed-western-imperialism-israel-us) and threatening the global economy
with his [disastrous war in Iran](http://m).

There is no reason to don a tuxedo and celebrate this racist wannabe tyrant.
There is nothing to be gained by showing up to the dinner with the hopes of
offering any small act of protest. Members of the industry should skip the
event instead, and refuse to provide a televised backdrop for Trump's vitriol
and hate.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**Zeteo** is a different kind of news outlet. We are an independent
organization funded by subscribers. We do not answer to billionaires or
corporate overlords. We seek to expose the truth and hold people in power to
account.

It's why the Trump White House [regularly attacks
us](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-white-house-attack-zeteo-iran-war), and our
founder **Mehdi**. It's why the White House has repeatedly refused to grant
press credentials to our journalists that would allow our team to ask tough
questions of the president and his propagandists.

**Zeteo** is getting under their skin - and we intend to stay there. To do so,
we need your help.
